content.title: Hailey Bieber Reveals Surprising Word Her, Justin Bieber's Son Jack Blues Bieber Can’t Stop Saying
content.text: time. I went to get him up from his nap today and he was like basketball. It'sHailey Bieber Reveals Word Her, Justin Bieber's Son Jack Can’t Stop Saying0 seconds of 1 minute, 32 secondsVolume 0%Hailey Bieber Reveals Word Her, Justin Bieber's Son Jack Can’t Stop SayingHailey Bieber is basking in her baby's milestones. The model shared that her and Justin Bieber’s 16-month-old son Jack Blues Bieber is not only speaking, but that he has a favorite word he can’t get enough of. "He says ‘basketball’ all the time," Hailey said on the Feb. 18 episode of the Therapuss With Jake Shane podcast. "I went to get him up from his nap today, and he was like 'basketball'. It's insane. So funny." And that’s not all. Hailey—who married Justin in 2018—also noted their baby boy has good manners. "He also just started saying please,” she revealed. “He knew how to sign please for a really long time. So if I would say, ‘Hey, say please', he would go this,” she said as she held up the American Sign Language term. “As please.” But Jack isn’t just signing, he’s also singing. Indeed, the Rhode Beauty founder shared her son is taking a page out of Justin’s book and loves to sing his dad’s hit “Baby.”“He’s been saying, ‘Baby, oh, baby, oh,’” the 31-year-old said as she mimicked her son’s voice. "Literally in the last two days." Plus, also much like his dad, the toddler has started to take an interest in sports. “He’s running,” she shared. “He’s kicking a soccer ball. He’s throwing a soccer ball. He’s into all of it.”Hailey Bieber/InstagramHailey’s motherhood era has been filled with fun surprises, especially as her son has gotten older and her anxiety surrounding parenting has faded. “When they’re so small it’s a lot scarier, but even so I was a lot more relaxed about everything than I thought,” she said about her motherhood experience. “Because I realized you just figure it out as you go. Like every single day you’re figuring out how to be a parent as you go, and you’re learning as they’re learning.”"I think it’s just the coolest thing to watch a little person become their own little person,” she added. “Like I’m watching him get his personality and see what he’s into.” And while Hailey’s having fun raising Jack, expanding her family isn’t out of the question. “I’m taking it one kid at a time,” she told Jake. “I definitely want one more. I’m not like in a rush, I definitely want one more. Maybe I'll have three. I don't know, I really don't know.
